blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Wednesday said it has 10 suspects in the alleged smuggling of 521 kilograms of suspected methamphetamine (‘shabu’) from Laos to the Philippines. The illegal drugs were reportedly transported in a private jet booked for US$49,500 (P3.1 million). “We already identified POIs (persons of interest),” the NBI said in a Viber message to reporters when asked if the bureau is also looking into the matter.
